lines.text: Heehee, transform.
Am I scary? You bet I am!
Am I a hero? That's a tough one...
Yes, it is I, the greatest villain of them all! Bow before me!
You want my signature too? Fine, I'll give it to you later.
What heinous crimes should I carry out today?
Hahahaha! Hahahahaha! *Cough, cough*
... Where did you go? Don't tell me you're off being evil without me!
My building, hand it over! If you don't have it, then never mind.
I like power plants. They give me a tingly feeling.
This place is great! Nice and quiet. Oops, I may have said that too loudly...
Heeheehee... Hahaha!
Hand over my enemies! Now!
Wow... I look pretty scary! Haha!
Time to get down to business.
What? Is this... for me?
I want them all! Are these all the offerings you have? Forget it then.
I'll repay you. What would you like? Just name it.
A moron like you won't pull the wool over my eyes.
Is it possible for a villain to feel love?
You're more than welcome to love me, but don't expect any in return!
Let's do this!
What?
Are you giving me an order? You best tread lightly.
Bring it on!
It's nice to be a hero every once in a while.
I need 10 seconds! No, uh, wait, 10 minutes.
Watch and learn.
It's a tough job, but someone's got to do it.
Cover me, and don't get yourself killed!
I'll do it slowly, hehe!
Hahaahaa!
There's more where that came from!
Time for the coup de grace! If it fails, forget I said it.
Heehee!
Hahaha!
Die!
Agh!
Ouch!
Ugh!
They didn't best me! I just tripped is all!
Did you see that? If not, then just ignore me.

I'm officially renaming Valentine's Day to Villaintine's Day!
If you're not on board, then forget I said anything.

Get your own dessert...
Fine, I guess that's supposed to be my job.

I will cast a curse to make it more delicious...
Ah, I mean... a spell?

If you want something to eat, just say so! 
I'll bring you anything you want.

Do you dig my new look?
I know I do.
I'll provide you with service that'll leave you satisfied, guaranteed.

Darn it,
this is digging into my time as a villain. Hurry up and get over here.

I'll go make some Villain Omurice.
Don't get your hopes up! This isn't meant for you.

If you're unsatisfied with my performance in any way, you can report me to the Maid Cafe.
However, as far as I know, they haven't received any complaints so far.

I'm handing out cookies to make people miserable!
Mwahahaha!

Come to the Maid Cafe if you want to see
what dastardly deeds I'm up to.

Are you the one I'm supposed to serve?
Pleasure to be working with you.

You should start calling me the Head Maid!
Huh? I'm unqualified for that position, you say?

I'll cook something really nice for you,
so stay tuned!

At this rate,
I could become a regular employee at the Maid Cafe.

Maids can receive gifts? This is great.
I want more!

Don't go falling in love with me,
'cause we're never gonna be together.

Hey.
Are you trying to bribe me?

Uh oh... I think we're starting to be on the same wavelength.
This is dangerous.
I could be your exclusive maid if you wanted.
I made this omurice especially for you, with lots of love.
This villainous maid is ready to rock and roll!
Huh? Someone is ordering already?
Figured.
Ready to serve.
He is under my protection!
Let's get this over with so we can go back.
I'll sweep you all up like it's nothing.
Keep calm and keep squirting the ketchup, everyone.
These maid outfits are such a nuisance.
Recharge!
You're finished now.
Open wide! Omurice coming right up!
Mwahahaha! How does it taste?
That was easier than I thought.
All clear.
These will make nice decorations at the cafe.
Ouch!
Ow!
*Gasp*
Agh, the villain omurice didn't work!
That's the power of being a maid!

Today, I'm a race car driver!
... And a villain.

Say, um... do you know anything about race car driving?
I don't, so I figured I'd ask.

The ultimate villain has to have her own wheels! 
... Paid in installments, of course.

Push the pedal to the metal!
But don't forget to always obey traffic laws.
I can lend you my car if you want, but don't you dare scuff it up.

Have you got a driver's license? You take the wheel, then.
I'm way too nervous to drive.
Where are you? Did you go to the race track without me?
I'll be here cleaning the car until you get back.

Hmm,
there isn't any place for racing here.
Jeez, is there any place here at all where you can drive?

We should build a nice, long stretch of road here!
But if we can't, that's fine too I guess.

I'm coming to pick you up!
Heh-heh... Are you waiting for me?
I can drive faster now.
Fire up your engines!

I've gotten stronger...
Wanna race?

If you've got more, then hand it over. I can put it in my trunk...
Oh, wait, this car doesn't have a trunk...
In return, I'll take you wherever you want to go.
Another gift? Why?
You're doing well, and quickly approaching the finish line.
You can ride shotgun.
Don't be so aggressive!
Heh-heh, my turn.
Is the green light on?
Go!
I'll set my precious car to the side for now.
Start your engines.
I'm the world's ultimate villain, and ultimate racer!
Buckle up, buttercup!

Don't rush!
Not unless it's urgent...
Push it into the redline!
Faster than a car? Never!
Let's rock n' roll.
Vroom vrooom vroom!
I'm overtaking you!
Nice kill.
Heh-heh, we took care of that quickly, didn't we?
Put it in the car.
Don't scratch the paint!
Ouch!
Agh!

I'm going back to my car...
but not to rest!
All right! Let's take the car for a spin.

favorite.name: Villain Figurine
favorite.description: There are times when the villain becomes the true star of the story, which is why some people find them more appealing than heroes. One thing is certain: without a villain, a story can easily lose its excitement.
